description: Pikzels (Dover, Delaware, USA — non-EU/Drittland) subscription receipts. 11 PDFs = exactly one $40 invoice per month Oct 2025-Jul 2026 (consecutive invoice number series PKZ-701489..PKZ-759818) plus one $0.00 trial invoice (PKZ-701487, excluded, no payment). The bank history has 16 lines, not 10: from Oct 2025 through Mar 2026 there are TWO Pikzels debits per month (labelled 'Pikzels' vs 'Pikzels PIKZELS.COM'), only ONE per month from Apr 2026 on. Only one invoice per month exists in this upload for the whole period, so for Oct'25-Mar'26 this manifest books against one of the two bank lines per month (the 'Pikzels'-labelled one, or the earlier date where both differ) and the OTHER line each month is left unmatched -- likely a second Pikzels subscription/account whose receipts were not included here. No VAT is shown on any invoice ('Tax to be paid on reverse charge basis'); booked at 0% as invoiced, same convention as ClickUp.
